title: Automating Options Spread
author: ogb-officials
selftext:
I have been testing automating spreads. This has been my experience so far

1. I open Spreads (call credit or put credit at 12). Strategy is just to look back at the last 30mins.

2. My goal is to collect 10%. Stops are 50% of the credit. This is not really good though, 1 stop can wipe 5 wins. However accuracy has been 100% so far

This is early tests so I can't say this is worth it
